sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN HEALTH SCIENCES WITH BIOLOGY
lines: Faculty of Health Sciences - Health Studies, School of
Completion of first-year requirements with no failures. Students must have an average of at least 70% with no grade less than 60% in 4.0 principal courses:
Health Sciences 1001A/B, Health Sciences 1002A/B, Health Sciences 1111A/B, and Health Sciences 1300A/B (each with a minimum grade of 70%);
Chemistry 1301A/B and Chemistry 1302A/B or the former Chemistry 1100A/B and the former Chemistry 1200B.

Students are advised to consult with an academic advisor prior to selecting their first-year courses to ensure that the appropriate prerequisite courses have been selected to allow registration in courses at the 2000-level or above.
3.5 courses (to be taken in second year): Health Sciences 2250A/B, Health Sciences 2400A/B, Health Sciences 2610F/G, Health Sciences 2700A/B, Health Sciences 2711A/B, Health Sciences 2800.
0.5 course (to be taken in third year): Health Sciences 3801A/B.
0.5 course from: Health Sciences at the 3000-level or above.
0.5 course from: Health Sciences at the 4000-level.
2.0 courses from: Biology 2581A/B, Biology 2382A/B, Biology 2483A/B, Biology 2471A/B, Biology 2485A/B, Biology 2601A/B.
0.5 course from: Biology 3316A/B, Biology 3592A/B, Biology 3601A/B, the former Biology 3332A/B.
0.5 course in Biology at the 2200-level or above, which may include courses listed above not already taken.

Note: a maximum of 12.0 credits (at the 1000-level or higher) from amongst Health Sciences, Rehabilitation Sciences, or Communication Sciences and Disorders courses, may be taken in any Specialization or Honours Specialization degree or module in the School of Health Studies.
